description: This file defines the ImplicitStreamPubSub class, which implements the IStreamPubSub interface for managing implicit stream subscriptions in Orleans. It includes methods for registering/unregistering producers and consumers, retrieving subscriptions, and creating subscription IDs, specifically for implicit subscriptions within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamPubSub
classes.description: Implements the IStreamPubSub interface to manage implicit stream subscriptions, including registration, unregistration, and subscription retrieval for Orleans streaming.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream, returning the set of subscription states.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specific stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer for a stream, supporting only implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a stream, supporting only implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a stream (stub implementation returning 0).

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a stream (stub implementation returning 0).

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription ID for a given stream and grain, only for implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Indicates whether a subscription has faulted (stub implementation returning false).

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscriber
methods.description: Checks if a grain ID or subscription ID is an implicit subscriber for a stream.
